data.one_liner: A Dart client for resumable file uploads using the tus protocol.
data.what_it_does: Allows pausing, resuming, and uploading files in chunks over the tus protocol. It supports persistent stores to recover uploads after app restarts.
use_when: You need to upload large files reliably with pause and resume capabilities.
Your backend server implements the tus resumable upload protocol.
avoid_when: Your backend does not support the tus protocol.
You only need standard simple HTTP file uploads without resumability.
strengths: Supports resumable uploads and pause/resume functionality.
Persistent URL stores allow recovery across app restarts.
Configurable chunk sizes and retry mechanisms.
weaknesses: Requires a server that supports the tus protocol.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer handling standard HTTP requests and custom upload logic yourself.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a full-featured HTTP client with built-in interceptors and cancellation tokens instead of a dedicated tus client.
